discovery.source_kind: Authorized local preorder window, pickup timing, SRPs and preorder offers
discovery.result: Official terms show the July 26–August 17, 2023 local preorder period; customers could get preorder units as early as August 11. Tab S9+ 256 GB preorders qualified for a free upgrade to 512 GB; the listed 512 GB preorder price was PHP 61,990 Wi-Fi or PHP 70,990 5G.

discovery.source_kind: Dated confirmation of Philippine store and online availability
discovery.result: Samsung Philippines reported the series available through participating local stores and online channels by September 6, 2023. This confirms local availability but not the exact first general-sale transaction.
Samsung Newsroom Philippines published Tab S9+ SRPs on September 8, 2023: Wi-Fi 12/256 PHP 61,990, Wi-Fi 12/512 PHP 69,990, 5G 12/256 PHP 70,990, and 5G 12/512 PHP 78,990.

discovery.source_kind: Global announcement, availability timing, support policy and shared model specifications
discovery.result: Samsung announced the Tab S9 series July 26, 2023. It identifies the Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 for Galaxy, IP68, included S Pen, Armor Aluminum and four OS generations plus five years of security updates.
Samsung says general availability in selected markets began August 11, 2023; additional markets followed later.
Samsung support states that Galaxy Tab S9 models support 45 W Fast Charging 2.0 with a compatible charger and cable. This does not imply the charger is included.

discovery.source_kind: Manufacturer SIM capability for model codes SM-X816B / SM-X810
discovery.result: Samsung's model-family table maps SM-X816B to the cellular model and identifies Nano-SIM (4FF) plus eSIM. The Wi-Fi-only SM-X810 does not take a SIM.

discovery.source_kind: Chip process and platform-level technical details
discovery.result: Qualcomm lists the Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 at 4 nm and a maximum CPU frequency up to 3.36 GHz; Samsung's exact Galaxy Tab S9+ local product pages identify the Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 for Galaxy.
Samsung's Galaxy Tab S9 product environmental report says four generations of OS upgrades and five years of security updates.

discovery.source_kind: Dated official local discount terms by storage and connectivity variant
discovery.result: Expired offer valid June 1–30, 2025. Samsung's terms list the exact Tab S9+ Wi-Fi/5G 256/512 GB SRPs and PHP 4,000 discounts; arithmetic prices are historical and not current offers.

discovery.result: Shopee displays PHP 70,985 and marks this exact Galaxy Tab S9+ 5G X816 12 GB / 256 GB listing Sold Out. Kimstore is the named seller; item condition and a usable current offer were not verified.

discovery.source_kind: Rights review for official product image
discovery.result: Samsung's site legal notice says Samsung or its licensors own site content and does not grant a reusable license for the product photograph. No exact-model openly licensed image was located in the reviewed Commons search; the public catalog keeps the neutral placeholder.
